question: List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. Only include the specific game records where they won with a handicap score of 190 or less at these three locations.
sql:
WITH venue_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    bs.BowlerID,
    bs.MatchID,
    bs.GameNumber,
    bs.HandiCapScore,
    bs.WonGame,
    t.TourneyLocation,
    t.TourneyDate
  FROM Bowler_Scores bs
  JOIN Bowlers b ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
  JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
  JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
  WHERE bs.WonGame = 1 
    AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
    AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
),
bowler_venues AS (
  SELECT 
    BowlerID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TourneyLocation) as venue_count
  FROM venue_wins
  GROUP BY BowlerID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TourneyLocation) = 3
)
SELECT 
  b.BowlerID,
  b.BowlerFirstName,
  b.BowlerLastName,
  vw.MatchID,
  vw.GameNumber,
  vw.HandiCapScore,
  vw.TourneyDate,
  vw.TourneyLocation
FROM venue_wins vw
JOIN bowler_venues bv ON vw.BowlerID = bv.BowlerID
JOIN Bowlers b ON vw.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
WHERE vw.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
ORDER BY b.BowlerID, vw.TourneyLocation, vw.MatchID, vw.GameNumber

SELECT t.TourneyID, t.TourneyLocation, COUNT(DISTINCT bs.BowlerID) as bowler_count
FROM Tourney_Matches tm
JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
JOIN Bowler_Scores bs ON tm.MatchID = bs.MatchID
WHERE bs.WonGame = 1 
  AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
  AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
GROUP BY t.TourneyID, t.TourneyLocation
ORDER BY t.TourneyLocation
